metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz: 813 Sharpa Wave rows (success after 613 controls) and solution/wuji/trajectory.npz: 821 Wuji Hand 2.2 rows (success after 621), both recorded from the authoring controller tools/controller.py (motor targets only). Each replays to success in two fresh processes with identical state hashes, also with float32-rounded rows. Harbor 0.23 on 2026-10-14: oracle 1 / nop 0 in both modes (standard: live = replay), Wuji oracle 1 in both modes, standard Wuji nop 0.

notes.layout: Each row is the left wrist stage (`l_wrist_x, l_wrist_y, l_wrist_z` in m, `l_wrist_rx, l_wrist_ry, l_wrist_rz` in rad), the right wrist stage (the same six, `r_wrist_*`), then the left hand's finger targets and the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`). Both hands use the same two stages, ranges, gains and start targets. With `sharpa` the left hand is a declared mirror image of the genuine right Sharpa Wave; with `wuji` both are the manufacturer's left and right Wuji Hand 2.2 models.
